classRules: class a requires accepted registration + >=3 views, >=2 deg, reproj RMS <=2 px, held-out median <=3 px, planes inlier RMS <=0.03 u & >=85% held-out within 0.05 u (thresholds.json). No component qualifies: every entry is class b.
topologyFindings: Walk order U+ -> U- along the rear corridor (2024 tenants): #16 Paris Baguette, #15 새벽집, staff stair core (직원식당), #14 개미집, #13 채선당, #12 BOX&CUP, #11 udon, #10 스시보노, café (K19, slot unresolved), #9 복순도가, U- escalator 1F->2F, #8 양산국밥, #7 SELF StoryWay, U- hall, GATE1 hall.
The staff stair rises between #15 and #14 directly off the corridor (SY0 206-218 s and tiV8 207-217 s agree).
The U- 1F->2F escalator is reached immediately after 복순도가 #9, before 양산국밥 #8 (SY0 308-312 s).

#17 lockers stand beside an escalator next to the 짐캐리 approach (62-77 s), continuous with 짐캐리 (77-84 s) and, via the pan at 115-116 s, with the U+ hall (elevator doors, AED, phones, yellow door) and KTX특송 / 김밥천국 pavilions under tall glazing (124-144 s).
Cross-video: RearRowWalkReg and UPlusEndReg registrations were also rejected; no accepted model exists to cross-check against.
